## Purchase Requisition (PR)

The internal buy request that starts the P2P audit trail: who needs what, by when, against which budget, and why. Lines reuse the shared `LineItem` field so the RFQ that follows copies them without translation. `estimatedTotal` is computed, never stored.

### Example

"Laptop refresh — 40 units" (converted-to-rfq): 40 laptops + 40 docks for the engineering cohort, against the IT Hardware FY2026 Q1 budget.

### Non-goals

No approval chain of its own — approval rigor lives on the Purchase Order, where money is actually committed. No requester self-service persona: the procurement manager records requisitions on requesters' behalf (single-persona rule). Converting to an RFQ is currently a manual step, not a command.
